title: Acceptance as average coordinate correction
statement: Let $n>0$, let $w:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a Boolean word, and let $p$ assign a Boolean proof value to each point of $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. The acceptance probability of the affine consistency tester on the word and proof equals the average, over a uniformly chosen coordinate $i$, of the probability that the local correction of the sign-valued function encoded by $p$ at the standard basis vector in coordinate $i$ agrees with the sign encoded by $w(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $n$
